content.text:
I read PR 142 and how chat and artifacts get their tools. Here's what I found. I haven't changed any code yet.

## PR 142: what it does and whether it fits

It has two independent fixes:

1. **Older messages in artifact chat.** Reopening a long artifact chat currently shows only the latest 30 messages. The PR adds "load older" with retry and duplicate removal. **This fits as-is.**
2. **Pages become checked TSX instead of free-form HTML.** Generated Pages run scripts (and load from jsdelivr) with your live financial data in `window.MONEO_DATA`. A prompt injection, such as a transaction description or a Scalable news snippet, could make the designer write a page that navigates to an outside URL with that data. The PR moves Pages to the same QuickJS → checked-tree renderer Home cards use. Old HTML versions stay viewable but inert.

**Localhost-only doesn't make #2 unnecessary.** The leak goes from your browser to the internet, not to your server. AGENTS.md says data may leave only for services you set up. So the risk is just as real on localhost as it was on Vercel.

**The trade-off:** Pages lose arbitrary JS such as free sliders, ECharts and custom inputs. They're limited to Kit charts, tabs and declared month/period/choice controls. Old pages need a rebuild to become interactive again.

**What needs changing to bring it in:**
- Rename the migration `202611050001_…` so it sorts after `202611070003_scalable_trade_cards.sql`.
- Drop the Vercel-era "deploy migration before the app" note. Locally, `npm run setup` applies it.
- Fix one merge conflict, in `docs/artifact-cards-architecture.html`. Everything else merges cleanly.
- Re-run the tests on top of the Scalable work.

## Artifact agent vs chat agent tools

Artifact chat already runs through the same `/api/chat` route (`app/api/chat/route.ts:273` and `:308`). The artifact agent already has every chat tool, including the Scalable reads and the trade cards. The only gap is that **Pages and cards can't show Scalable data**. The designer only sees data from saved queries (`ARTIFACT_SOURCES` in `lib/ai/artifact-data.ts`), and none of those read Scalable. The agent can read your portfolio but can't build a live portfolio page.

**Fix:** add Scalable sources (portfolio, transactions, security quote/chart, watchlist) to the artifact queries, offered only when Scalable is connected. Two decisions:
- **Data on each page open:** use the live Scalable read every time, or the `portfolio` snapshot saved at the last sync (faster, no live call)? I'd use live for quotes and charts and the snapshot for the portfolio.
- **Trading from inside a Page:** I'd say no. Trades stay as chat cards you tap, as agreed in the trading work.

## Showing Scalable tools based on connection and access

- **Connection:** this already works. The `investments_*` tools only exist when there's an active connection and the AI is allowed to see accounts (`route.ts:96`). With no Scalable, the agent gets no Scalable tools. The new artifact sources would use the same check.
- **Full vs read-only:** this is missing. The order and cancel tools appear whenever you mention trading. With read-only access they just return `readOnly`. The access level isn't stored anywhere; it's worked out live by asking Scalable which tools it offers (`tradingAccess` in `lib/scalable/live.ts:22`).
  - **Proposal:** save the access level on the Scalable connection when you connect and on each sync, via a small migration. Add the order and cancel tools only when it's `full`.
  - Make the two Scalable lines in the system prompt (`lib/ai/provider.ts:55-56`) depend on it too: no Scalable lines when it isn't connected, and a "read-only, trading unavailable" line when it's read-only. The voice call uses the same route, so it gets this automatically.
  - I'd recheck the access level on reconnect and on sync rather than on every chat. Checking on every chat adds an extra call to Scalable each time.

## Order I'd suggest

1. Bring in PR 142 with the fixes above.
2. Store the access level and gate the order tools and prompt on it.
3. Add the Scalable artifact sources.

Each would be its own commit.

**Two questions:** are you OK with Pages losing free-form JS in exchange for closing the leak? And for the portfolio on Pages, live data or the last-sync snapshot?

content.text:
I've made two commits on a new branch, `t3/artifact-scalable`. Unit tests (1,365) and lint pass. I haven't run the app or a browser test, and nothing is pushed.

- **`4872ce43`: older messages in artifact chat.** This is the only part of PR 142 I took: a long artifact chat now has an "Older messages" button.
- **`03c7e410`: order cards only when Scalable can trade.** Each sync now saves whether the Scalable login has full or read-only access. On read-only, the buy/sell/cancel tools are left out and the agent is told to explain why. Logins that haven't synced since this change keep the tools, which still check with Scalable before showing a card.
  - With no Scalable connected, the agent already got no Scalable tools; that hasn't changed.
  - Chat, artifact chat and voice all go through the same route, so all three get this.
  - **Before you run it:** `npm run setup` has to apply the new migration `202611070004`. Until then, chat will act as if Scalable isn't connected.
  - If you switch Scalable to full access in their app, Moneo only notices at the next sync. That's daily, or "Sync now" on Import.

## What I left out of PR 142

I left out the rewrite of Pages into checked TSX, its migration and the frozen old HTML, since you want Pages to keep JS. One idea from it is worth keeping, though. Pages with JS can still leak your data by sending the page to an outside URL. We can close most of that without losing JS:
- Put the page inside a wrapper whose CSP only allows frames from Moneo itself, so the page can't navigate away.
- Serve the chart libraries from Moneo instead of jsdelivr. Pages would then also work offline.
- One gap no browser setting closes: WebRTC calls in Chrome. That risk is small.

## Sliders in Home widgets

Today a widget's code runs on the server. Each month/period switch asks the server to rebuild it. Three ways to add sliders:

| Option | Good | Bad |
|---|---|---|
| **A. Slider, toggle and number controls; the card's code reruns in your browser** | Instant while dragging, keeps the Moneo look, and the code still can't reach the network | Only these built-in controls, not any JS; the browser has to download the engine (QuickJS, ~1 MB), loaded only by cards that have sliders |
| B. Same controls, but the server rebuilds on each change | Least code | Laggy: every drag reruns the data queries |
| C. Widgets become HTML+JS frames like Pages | Full freedom | One frame per card on Home is heavy, sizing and dark mode get harder, and the leak risk sits on the page you open most |

**I recommend A.** Pages could use the same controls next to their own JS.

## What Wealth has from Scalable

Each sync, Scalable saves:
- **Each holding:** name, shares, price, value and what you paid, saved by date so the value chart has history.
- **Crypto and cash.**
- **Totals:** total, securities, crypto and cash, plus gain per period.
- **The last 8 trades and cash moves, and up to 12 watchlist items.**

Artifacts can already read the holdings through the existing `wealth` source. They can't read the totals, gains, trades or watchlist.

## Live data vs last-sync snapshot

| | Live from Scalable | Last-sync snapshot |
|---|---|---|
| Freshness | Prices right now | Up to a day old (labelled "as of") |
| What's there | Everything: any stock, price charts, news, full trade list | Only what's listed above |
| Speed | 1–3 s on every open, and on every Home visit for widgets | Instant |
| When Scalable is down or the login expired | Shows an error | Still works |
| Matches Wealth and net worth | Can differ | Same numbers |
| Calls to Scalable | Many | None |

**I'd mix them:** portfolio, holdings, totals, trades and watchlist from the snapshot, and live only for stock quotes and charts, which the snapshot doesn't have. Home widgets would use the snapshot only.

**Your call on three things:**
1. The mixed approach for Scalable data in Pages and widgets?
2. Option A for widget sliders?
3. Should I add the Page protection described above?
